clinical_category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

semantic_correction.stem: A unit has completed an audit of staff adherence to infection-prevention practices. Which follow-up action directly reflects CDC Core Infection Prevention and Control Practices?

options.A: Provide prompt, regular feedback on adherence and related outcomes to staff and facility leadership.
options.B: File the audit results for the annual report without sharing current findings with staff.
options.C: Repeat monitoring after an infection cluster occurs rather than using the current audit findings.
options.D: Replace further monitoring with a policy reminder because the audit has already been completed.

semantic_correction.rationale: CDC Core Infection Prevention and Control Practices identify performance monitoring and feedback as a core practice. Facilities should monitor adherence to infection-prevention practices and provide prompt, regular feedback on adherence and related outcomes to healthcare personnel and facility leadership. Option A directly implements this recommendation. Options B, C, and D withhold timely feedback, defer monitoring until a problem emerges, or substitute a reminder for ongoing performance monitoring.
semantic_correction.educational_objective: Use infection-prevention audit data for prompt, regular feedback to healthcare personnel and facility leadership as part of ongoing performance improvement.

semantic_correction.correction_summary_append: RULE1 cleanup: replaced a definition-style item with a post-audit nursing quality scenario, removed the uniquely long correct answer and absolute distractor, and tied the item to CDC Core Practice 4 and current NCSBN 2026 safety/infection-prevention activity statements.

audit_findings_append.finding: The original principle was accurate but the correct answer was uniquely longest and distractors were weak. The revised item requires selection of the CDC-recommended follow-up to an actual adherence audit: prompt, regular feedback to staff and leadership.

option_audit.A: Correct. It directly matches CDC Core Practice 4's feedback requirement after adherence monitoring.
option_audit.B: Incorrect. Archiving data without sharing current findings omits the prompt, regular feedback component.
option_audit.C: Incorrect. CDC performance monitoring is not limited to periods after infection clusters and should use current adherence data.
option_audit.D: Incorrect. A policy reminder does not replace ongoing monitoring and feedback.

ambiguity_check: No second defensible answer. A is the only option that directly implements the CDC feedback action specified for performance monitoring.
cueing_check: All four choices are post-audit management actions of comparable length and detail; no absolute-word or unique-length cue identifies A.
